features.description: Phased gate evaluation in dispatch_volley. pre_impl-phase gates are checked before iteration 0 (current behavior). pre_merge-phase gates are checked ONLY after the volley terminates with final_status=signed_off, and BEFORE any merge step would land. Other terminal states (stopped_*, paused_on_gate, blocked) skip pre_merge entirely. A small phase-classification mapping lives alongside gate_pause; unknown gate names default to pre_impl for backward compatibility. INBOX events for pre_merge pauses reference the signoff_id so the operator knows what they are approving.
steps: Add gate-phase classification helper (e.g. gate_pause.classify_phase(name) -> 'pre_impl'|'pre_merge') with default-to-pre_impl for unknown names
Refactor supervisor.dispatch_volley so the upfront _check_gates evaluates only pre_impl-phase gates
Add post-signoff pre_merge evaluation in _emit_volley_terminal (or equivalent) gated on final_status == 'signed_off'
Update INBOX gate_hit writer for pre_merge to include signoff_id and post-iteration timing context
Decide pre_merge behavior on needs_changes / re-iterate paths (likely: pre_merge does NOT fire — sign-off is binary)
Update existing F008 tests that asserted upfront pre_merge pause; add new tests for post-signoff timing and skip-on-non-signoff terminals
Run regression sweep across all F008 + supervisor test modules
Empirical re-run: changelog plan or a fresh trivial sub-plan, confirm phased semantics in audit/gate-state.json + INBOX.md
features.acceptance: (1) Synthetic plan with always-sign-off mock executor pauses only on pre_impl before iter 0; after clearing pre_impl, volley signs off, then supervisor re-pauses on pre_merge with INBOX event referencing the signoff_id. (2) Synthetic plan that terminates with stopped_budget produces NO pre_merge pause; gate-state.json shows pre_merge as still un-cleared but supervisor terminates without re-prompting. (3) All F008 + supervisor tests green. (4) Dogfood re-run confirms phased semantics empirically.
